function.name: say

message.description: The message to be broadcasted in the chat.

function.name: plan
function.description: Articulate a strategic plan detailing the steps to achieve specific goals, providing the rationale for the chosen approach. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

how.description: Detailed step-by-step actions required to attain the desired goals.

what.description: The final objectives or outcomes that the plan aims to achieve.

why.description: The reasoning behind choosing this specific plan of action over alternatives.

function.name: no_op
function.description: A placeholder function that performs no operation and returns no value. It can be used as a stub in code where a specific function interface is required but no action is desired. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: move_to
function.description: Move an object to a specified 3D coordinate (x, y, z). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x.description: The x coordinate (horizontal axis) to move to, in units.

y.description: The y coordinate (vertical axis) to move to, in units.

z.description: The z coordinate (depth axis) to move to, in units.

function.name: toss_item
function.description: Remove an item of a specified type from the player's inventory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_type.description: The unique identifier for the type of item to be removed from the inventory.

function.name: look
function.description: Adjust the viewing angle of the camera to a specific orientation defined by yaw and pitch values in radians. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

pitch.description: The angle in radians to point up or down. 0 radians means straight forward. Positive values up to pi/2 radians mean pointing upwards, and negative values down to -pi/2 radians mean pointing downwards. This is a float type value.

yaw.description: The angle in radians for rotation around the vertical axis, starting from due east and rotating counter-clockwise. This is a float type value.

function.name: look_at
function.description: Orients the view to focus on a specific 3D coordinate in a virtual space. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x.description: The x coordinate (horizontal axis) to look at. It is specified in meters. This is a float type value.

y.description: The y coordinate (vertical axis) to look at. It is specified in meters. This is a float type value.

z.description: The z coordinate (depth axis) to look at. It is specified in meters. This is a float type value.
